name: SearchDatabase

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The keyword to search for databases
parameters.help_zh: 搜索数据库名称的关键字
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The environment type of the database. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据库的环境类型，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en:
The permission scope. Valid values:

- **HAS\_PERMSSION**: databases that you have permissions on.

- **OWNER**: databases that you own.

- **MY\_FOCUS**: databases that you follow.

- **UNKNOWN**: all databases
parameters.help_zh:
权限范围，取值如下：
- **HAS_PERMSSION**：有权限的数据库
- **OWNER**：我Owner的数据库
- **MY_FOCUS**：我关注的数据库
- **UNKNOWN**：不限
parameters.name: search_range

parameters.help_en:
The search target. Valid values:

- **DB**: all databases, including physical and logical databases.

- **SINGLE\_DB**: physical databases.

- **LOGIC\_DB**: logical databases
parameters.help_zh:
搜索目标，取值如下：
- **DB**：不限（不区分单库或逻辑库）
- **SINGLE_DB**：单库
- **LOGIC_DB**：逻辑库
parameters.name: search_target

parameters.help_en: The database engine type. For more information about the valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The method for sorting the query results. Valid values:

- **LAST\_ACTIVE\_TIME**: sorts the results by the last active time.

- **DB\_NAME**: sorts the results by the database name
